rows.en: Yamato: "You'd better not..."
Touya: "But I won't know unless I ask, right?"
Yamato: "But..."
Aurelie: "...What?"
Touya: "There's something I wanted to ask..."
Aurelie: "?"
Touya: "When Kasumi said she'd get into a Spirit Mech,
Clovis said something..."
Aurelie: "..."
Yamato: "See? I knew it..."
Touya: "You don't want to talk about it after all..."
Aurelie: "...It isn't an entertaining story, you know."
Touya: "That's fine. Would you tell me anyway?"
Aurelie: "Well, all right.
...Spirit Mechs do too, but Armored Mechs offer their pilots
quite a lot of protection.
So fighting felt like a game,
and death seemed a long way away...
But during that live combat exercise with the Spirit Mechs,
terrorists suddenly attacked..."
Touya: "And someone on the other side died in the fight?"
Aurelie: "Yes... It was an old machine, and it looked like
they couldn't even maintain it properly.
But even with its weapons destroyed and its head crushed,
it kept coming at me. Honestly, I was scared...
Then it latched onto Parikar.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02>I desperately tried to shake it off. But it
wouldn't let go, as if it were stuck to me... Then
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:03>I lost my balance... And that Armored Mech ended up underneath..."
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "I still remember how it felt.
The sound of a person being crushed, and a dying scream...
I shouldn't have been able to hear it, but I know
I heard it...
Then, the instant I thought, 'I killed them... I killed a person...'
I couldn't stop shaking.
This was combat. We were killing each other..."
Touya: "Yeah... You're right..."
Aurelie: "For a while after that, I couldn't get into a Spirit Mech.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:F0>Clovis is the reason I could fight again."
Touya: "Huh... That Clovis?"
Aurelie: "He kept fussing over me even though I hadn't asked,
but he never told me to try harder or stop feeling down...
He just did stupid things.
But seeing him do that all the time, it slowly started to feel
silly to sit there moping by myself.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:03><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:05>Strange, isn't it? Feeling that way after killing someone.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:F0>But it saved me.
That's why I can still fight without falling apart.
By facing the fact that I killed someone with my own hands,
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:04>and living with that knowledge."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "..."
Aurelie: "...Oh.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:11><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:10><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:F4>Hahaha. That got a little gloomy.
I told you it wasn't an entertaining story, didn't I?"
Touya: "No, um... I don't know what to say..."
Aurelie: "Well, that's what fighting means.
You don't have to overthink it, but when you come face to face
with that reality, being prepared or unprepared makes all the
difference.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:03><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:02><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:F0>...Well, that's the end of the story. Satisfied?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Aurelie: "Well, I've got something to do now."
Touya: "Yeah. Sorry I pushed you..."
Aurelie: "You didn't.
If I didn't want to talk, I wouldn't have. See you."
Touya: "Being ready to fight... Huh."
Aurelie: "I don't like people prying."
Touya: "I see..."
Aurelie: "I've got something to do. See you."
